newsitem.title: USA: Guidant to file with FDA for stent by mid-1997.
newsitem.headline: Guidant to file with FDA for stent by mid-1997.

text.p: Guidant Corp said on Tuesday that is expects to file a pre-market approval application for its ACS multi-link stent by mid-1997.

At the Piper Jaffray Medical Device Conference in New York, chief executive Ronald Dollens said that the company expects to file the application mid-year, but declined to project how long a U.S. Food and Drug Administration review would take and when the company would bring the device to the U.S. market.
"There is no reason the FDA can't be incredibly efficient," Dollens said.
The stents, which are devices that keep blood vessels open, are marketed in Europe.
